subject: VM evidence handback for SOC2 / SIG audit - scan forensics & remediation timelines
messages:
From: Thomas Gray <t.gray@secureaudit.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: audit-ops@brightbank.com
Date: 2028-12-10T16:22:00Z
Subject: Request: VM forensics + remediation timeline (SOC2 control testing)

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the questionnaire. As part of BrightBank's control testing window we need the following artefacts to complete our VM evidence review: 

- Weekly authenticated scanner logs (last 90 days) with scan schedule metadata (cron/timezone).
- Proof of remediation for Critical and High CVEs (ID, affected component, first seen date, fix date, rollback notes if any).
- A short attestation on SLA commitments for CVE triage & remediation (what counts as critical / SLA buckets).
- Any forensics or root-cause notes for the three CVEs flagged in our tracker: CVE-2028-81123, CVE-2028-91211, CVE-2028-70002.

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Tuesday (2028-12-12)? If there are granular pieces you cannot share (sensitive PII), let us know alternatives.

Thanks,
Thomas
Senior IT Auditor
SecureAudit Partners

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Gray <t.gray@secureaudit.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-12-11T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM forensics + remediation timeline (SOC2 control testing)

Thomas —

Acknowledged. We'll deliver a compiled packet. Quick notes up front: 

- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans (internal Nessus-based flow + complementary SCA once per month). Scans run Sundays 02:00 UTC, with incremental checks during weekdays for newly onboarded images.
- SLA tiers we commit to internally: Critical = 7 days to detection-to-fix plan (we aim for 48–72hr full remediation for infra-critical issues), High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days. These are reflected in our remediation matrix.
- For the three CVEs you called out we have remediation artifacts for two (CVE-2028-81123, CVE-2028-70002) and an open mitigated-in-place plan for CVE-2028-91211 (temporary compensating control while patch propagation is scheduled).

I'll attach the weekly scan bundle and the remediation matrix; Kimberly and Marissa are on copy for any deeper forensic exports. If you need signed attestation language, we can provide that as well.

Thanks — sending files now.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_weekly-auth-scan-log-202811.zip (contains weekly logs), cve_remediation_matrix_q4_2028.xlsx

From: BrightBank Audit Ops <audit-ops@brightbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, t.gray@secureaudit.com
Date: 2028-12-11T18:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM forensics + remediation timeline (SOC2 control testing)

Vanessa —

Appreciate the quick reply. A couple of clarifying requests before we sign off: 

1) For the Critical CVE remediation (CVE-2028-81123) we need sha256 of the patched binaries or checksum of deployed container images + a short deployment timeline showing when the fix reached production.
2) For the CVE you marked mitigated-in-place (CVE-2028-91211) can you confirm the compensating control, who approved the exception, and the target remediation date?
3) Please confirm whether your authenticated scans include credentialed checks against ephemeral test accounts (we need proof that creds are rotated and vaulted).

If you can deliver the three items and the forensics text file for CVE-2028-81123 by Tue 12/12 17:00 UTC, we'll be able to close our sampling.

Best,
BrightBank Audit Ops

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: audit-ops@brightbank.com, t.gray@secureaudit.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-12-12T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM forensics + remediation timeline (SOC2 control testing)

Team —

Final handback below; attaching three artifact stubs and a short attestation. Summary of deliverables included in the packet:

- redwood_weekly-auth-scan-log-202811.zip: weekly authenticated scan logs (11/01/2028 - 11/30/2028), plus scan-schedule.txt (cron: 0 2 * * 0 UTC). Logs redacted for customer-identifying data per contract.

- cve_remediation_matrix_q4_2028.xlsx: rows include CVE id, component, severity, first-seen, triage-date, fix-deployed, fix-checksum (sha256 for images), remediation-owner. In particular: 
  - CVE-2028-81123: fix-deployed 2028-11-23T04:12:00Z, image-sha256: a3f4b2...9d8 (full value in attached spreadsheet). Deployment reached prod via canary rollout 2028-11-23 to 2028-11-25.
  - CVE-2028-70002: fix-deployed 2028-10-12T22:05:00Z.
  - CVE-2028-91211: currently mitigated-in-place (network ACL + WAF rule), exception approved by Kimberly Park on 2028-11-30 (approval stored in our compliance vault). Target full patch window: 2029-01-15. Approval reference: HBSP-342194.

- critical-cve-20281123-forensics.txt: short root-cause notes (vuln introduced via dependency bump in package manager; exploitability limited in our runtime due to sandboxing; timeline of discovery -> triage -> patch -> verification).

Attestation (signed by me): "Redwood Inference confirms that the attached VM artifacts are accurate exports from our production scan and remediation systems for the dates indicated. Our internal SLA tiers (Critical: 7 days to remediation plan; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days) were followed for the items included in this packet. Sensitive details (customer PII) have been redacted. For full forensic exports under NDA escalation, contact security-legal@redwood.com."

If you need a formal signature page (PDF) or a GPG-signed checksum of the ZIP, we can provide those by tomorrow morning.

Thanks — looping Kim and Marissa for records retention confirmation.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_weekly-auth-scan-log-202811.zip, cve_remediation_matrix_q4_2028.xlsx, critical-cve-20281123-forensics.txt
